note: Weekly trend run (MOD_PLAN.md section 1 'Trend goal'): the daily preset against itself, same binary. The base numbers are the trend point of the week (decode short / edit, prompt long1k / long3k / long64k); the base-again arm is the noise floor of the box that week (any 'difference' it shows is noise). Run once a week on a quiet box with --tier confirm --block 3 --warmup 1 --outlier robust --reclaim-max 3 --reps 5 --no-early-stop, rebuild build-win from the line's HEAD first, one TEST_LEDGER.md row per run.
